name: fgFenceRun
description: a long run of weathered grey timber post and rail fence seen close up and side on, four posts and two rails crossing the whole width, tufts of dry grass at the feet of the posts, low top-down farm view, no background

name: fgWeeds
description: a big untidy clump of tall dry roadside weeds and thistles, seed heads and broad dock leaves, close up and foreground scale, low top-down farm view, no background

name: fgFeedSacks
description: a stack of four burlap feed sacks leaning against each other, one split open with grain spilling out, close up and foreground scale, low top-down farm view, no background

name: fgCartWheel
description: a large old wooden cart wheel with an iron rim leaning against nothing, half sunk in dry grass, close up and foreground scale, low top-down farm view, no background

name: fgTrough
description: a long galvanised steel water trough seen close up and side on, rusted at the seams, a dark puddle spreading under one end, trodden mud around it, low top-down farm view, no background

name: fgMilkChurns
description: three tall dented steel milk churns standing together, lids askew, close up and foreground scale, low top-down farm view, no background
